cohort: 212 nulliparous women with term, singleton pregnancies and vertex presentation at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Induction of labor, nighttime delivery, prolonged labor, and birth weight <3kg were associated with an increased cesarean section rate among nulliparous women with term, singleton pregnancies and vertex presentation.
mod_finding: Induction of labor, nighttime delivery, prolonged labor, and birth weight <3kg were associated with an increased cesarean section rate among nulliparous women with term, singleton pregnancies and vertex presentation.
